_meta.description: Candidate lunar south-pole outpost sites. Values marked verified:true are reproducible NASA product samples; unverified values are gameplay placeholders. A LEND hydrogen signature indicates resource potential, not confirmed or extractable water ice.
_meta.how_to_fill: First choose and record each site's latitude/longitude. In QuickMap or the PDS, record the exact product/layer/version, source URL, read date, original value/unit, and sampling/averaging method for LOLA elevation/slope, WAC illumination, and LEND hydrogen. Do not convert LEND data to water yield without a cited transformation.

sites.name: Ridge A
sites.description: Game label for a sampled point in NASA LOLA's Connecting Ridge landing-site dataset. Hydrogen is a LEND regional model estimate for the >88° polar band, not a landing-point assay.

coordinates.source: Derived from the shared south-polar stereographic coordinate X=-17,550 m, Y=-11,850 m; planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude

illumination_pct.source: NASA PDS LRO/LROC WAC_POLE_ILL_PCT_SOUTH_100M v2.0, urn:nasa:pds:lro-l-lroc-5-rdr:lrolrc_2001_data:bdr.wac_pole.wac_pole_ill_pct_south.wac_pole_ill_pct_south_100m; column 782, line 725

elevation_m.source: NASA GSFC PGDA LOLA 5 m Connecting Ridge LDEM, Site01_final_adj_5mpp_surf.tif; X=-17,550 m, Y=-11,850 m; pixel column 290, row 1570

slope_deg.source: NASA GSFC PGDA LOLA 5 m Connecting Ridge slope map, Site01_final_adj_5mpp_slp.tif; X=-17,550 m, Y=-11,850 m; pixel column 290, row 1570

hydrogen_ppm.source: NASA NTRS 20180004020, LEND regional model: ~140 ppmw H above 88° latitude (0.13 ± 0.02 wt% WEH). Supporting NASA PDS LEND_RDR_ALDS_20090915 map cell centered -89.25°, 235.75°: CSETN relative rate 5.22 ± 0.26; regional model is used because the locked field requires ppm and this product stores count rates.
